source.title: Pembrolizumab for Early Triple-Negative Breast Cancer

reported_trial_facts.event_free_survival_hazard_ratio_context: Early exploratory event-count comparison at median 15.5 months follow-up; NOT the later confirmatory EFS interim analysis reported in 2022.
reported_trial_facts.pcr_interim_sample_context: First 602 randomized participants, not the full 1174 randomized trial population.

controls.note: Discovery-only, 2020 paper facts cross-checked against PubMed PMID 32101663. Later 2022 EFS publication and 2026 FDA labels are outcome/post-decision sources and excluded. No authenticated point-in-time snapshot or source-byte hash; not eligible for frozen blind input.
